Intake note (Commercial team, 8 August 2020). Our client Uma Chauhan is a 73-year-old schoolteacher who lives at Bungalow 25, Koregaon Park, Pune 411046 and can be reached on +91 60028 14419 or uma.chauhan@example.in. The client's PAN WJJPC7260Q.
The client consulted us about a wrongful termination matter against Goyal Industries. The wrongful termination claim against M/s Goyal Industries is for ₹22,80,000; the employee was dismissed without any enquiry.
The matter was filed as Complaint No. 2451/2020 before the Pune Labour Court on 4 October 2020.
